build_unsupervised_model: build an unsupervised fastText model from a list of text lines with training kwargs
build_supervised_model: build a supervised fastText model from a list of text lines with training kwargs
gen_unit_tests: generate a unittest class with dynamically created fastText unit test methods for various model settings
gen_tests: generate integration test cases for supervised fastText models from configuration and data directory
get_random_data: generate random text data lines with configurable vocabulary size and word count per line
